source:
@@U02899@@
Ah! And there they are, a stray one or two fluttering out! Up with you now! Up and away, you little darlings! Hide, you hear? Here and there! Every dust-layered corner and niche! There are thousands waiting for you to call them home! Old paper boxes standing about, this crusty brown parchment, dusty shards of age-old pottery, or the empty sockets of those skulls on the shelf! In a place as moldy and mangy as this, strange things will breed in the mind as well as the dust.

@@U02900@@
(He slips into the robe.)

@@U02901@@
Come, cover my shoulders one more time! I'll play the principal part in our little show as well as act the boss. But how can I be that when there’s no one here knows me? (He pulls the bell cord, causing a shrill, piercing sound to make the walls tremble and the doors to burst open.)

@@U02903@@
(Enters, staggering out of a long, dark corridor.)

@@U02904@@
What a clanging! What a terror! Stairs sway, walls quiver, storm and lightning threaten through the painted panes! The floor gives way, and rubble and mortar rain down on my head! And this door, locked and bolted to entry, threw back its bolts at the force of some magic power!
translation:
@@U02899@@
啊！它们就在那儿，一两只流浪的飞出来！现在就和你一起吧！起来吧，你们这些小可爱们！躲起来，听到了吗？这里和那里！每个积满灰尘的角落和壁龛！有成千上万的人等着你叫他们回家！旧纸盒立在那里，这张硬皮的棕色羊皮纸，布满灰尘的古老陶器碎片，或者架子上那些头骨的空插座！在这样一个发霉、肮脏的地方，心里就会滋生奇怪的东西，灰尘也会滋生。

@@U02900@@
（他穿上长袍。）

@@U02901@@
来吧，再捂住我的肩膀！我将在我们的小节目中扮演主角并扮演老大。但这里没人认识我，我怎么可能是这样呢？ （他拉动门铃绳，发出尖锐刺耳的声音，使墙壁颤抖，门猛然打开。）

@@U02903@@
（走进去，摇摇晃晃地走出一条又长又黑的走廊。）

@@U02904@@
多么叮叮当当啊！多么恐怖啊！楼梯摇晃，墙壁颤抖，暴风雨和闪电透过彩绘玻璃发出威胁！地板塌陷，瓦砾和灰浆如雨点般落到我的头上！这扇门，锁着，插在入口处，在某种魔力的作用下，门闩又弹回来了！
